# Infiltrator
Infiltrators are a critical member of the team with a kit meant for breaking and entering, usually to steal valuable items or sabotage machines.
## Tools of the Trade Their cache contains an EMAG, two C-4 charges, and a bag with a full set of chameleon clothes for quick disguise changes.
### EMAG Can be used to open any airlock or locker, damaging them in the process and bolting open airlocks.
### C4 Blows up whatever is on the tile it's on, and not much else. Great for breaching, but not that good at damaging players. Must be planted to arm; cannot be manually activated like other explosives.
### Chameleon Kit Special clothing that can change its appearance to look like almost any other piece of clothing. Don't forget that the bag is also a part of the kit, too.
